title: Theater in Review: Upper Austria

description.main: Edited by Christopher Williams, this book publishes the complete transcript of a 1973 ZDF panel discussion on Franz Xaver Kroetz's play Upper Austria, which the broadcaster cancelled because of Kroetz's Communist Party affiliation. It was published for Williams's 2024 exhibition Radio/Rauhfaser/Television at the Neubauer Collegium, University of Chicago.
description.extended:
Edited by Christopher Williams, Theater in Review: Upper Austria publishes for the first time the complete transcript of a 1973 panel discussion on Franz Xaver Kroetz's play Upper Austria, which the West German broadcaster ZDF cancelled because of Kroetz's Communist Party affiliation.

The panel, with Kroetz, Dieter Braun, Ludwig Hankofer, Dieter Schnabel and Hans-Georg Frieser, was recorded at the ZDF-Landesstudio Bayern in Unterföhring on 1 March 1973. The transcript is joined by newspaper articles, opinion pieces and open letters written after the cancellation, and by an introduction from Dieter Roelstraete, curator at the Neubauer Collegium. Maximilian Klemens Sänger translated the texts and Petra Hollenbach designed the 60-page softcover. The book was published for Williams's exhibition Radio/Rauhfaser/Television at the Neubauer Collegium for Culture and Society, University of Chicago, from 8 February to 19 April 2024.

Williams, born in Los Angeles in 1956, has carried out a long study of Kroetz's work for theatre, radio and television. The Chicago exhibition centred on Kroetz's radio play Inklusive, which Williams recorded with vintage East and West German audio equipment and which Lumpen Radio broadcast during the show.

notes: Title: Zwirner and AbeBooks spell 'Theatre'; the printed cover reads 'Theater in Review: Upper Austria'. Panelist name: Zwirner text gives 'Ludwig Hannover', the cover gives 'Ludwig Hankofer' (cover spelling used). Zwirner's hi-res cover image (740dafaab...-1772x2717.jpg) credits 'Edited with introduction by Christopher Williams' and appears to be a pre-production mockup. The AbeBooks trade image (326×500) reads 'Edited by Christopher Williams / With introduction by Dieter Roelstraete', which matches Zwirner's text, so it was used despite low resolution. Pages: Zwirner 60; one retailer reports 62 (unverified).
